title: MiniMax 3D Director Stage: block scenes before H3 generation
summary: Practitioner notes on MiniMax Design's 3D Director Stage: block figures, walls, and camera paths in 3D before generating, but H3 still follows text prompts harder than camera references—use the stage for composition, not frame accuracy.
question_it_answers: When should I use MiniMax 3D Director Stage instead of fighting H3 for exact camera-frame matching?

claims.text: MiniMax 3D Director Stage lets you block a scene in 3D—placing figures, walls, and a camera path—before generating video.
claims.evidence: MiniMax Design's 3D Director Stage lets you block the scene in actual 3D — place the figure, the walls, the camera path — and generate from that.
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

claims.text: H3 follows the text prompt harder than the camera reference, so the stage is best for composition and space rather than frame accuracy.
claims.evidence: H3 follows your text prompt harder than your camera reference. Stop fighting for frame accuracy and use the stage for what it's good at — composition and space.
